"'''Specimen A'''" was a [[Cloning|cloned]] [[Zillo Beast]] that broke free from its captivity and [[Silla cloned Zillo Beast incident|wreaked havoc]] on the [[planet]] [[Silla]] during or after [[18 BBY]]. The beast was held in an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[science vessel]] before it got loose and ate the crew, causing the [[Transport 904|vessel]] to crash.

==Biography==
Specimen A was a clone of the Zillo beast that attacked [[Coruscant]] during the Clone War. After Tipoca City on Kamino was destroyed, the Galactic Empire recovered the cloning technology to carry out Emperor Palpatine's project to clone the creature he planned after the death of the last Zillo beast.

During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|211}}</ref> "Specimen A" was held in a [[Transport 904|transport]] and was originally planned to be sent to a [[Tantiss Base|scientific facility]] in [[Mount Tantiss]], on the [[planet]] [[Wayland]]. Due to an unforeseen incident, the [[Zillo Beast]] escaped its captivity and ate the crew aboard. The event caused the transport to crash on the nearby [[forest]] planet of [[Silla]].<ref name="Metamorphosis" />

The beast was discovered in a juvenile form by [[Clone Force 99]] when they went to explore the wreckage of the ship. The beast consumed the energy of the transport and grew larger shortly before escaping and making its way toward the [[Silla's solar farm|solar farm]] of a nearby [[Unidentified village (Zillo Beast)|village]]. The Zillo Beast quickly consumed even more energy from the farm until it grew to a much larger size. [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces then came to retrieve the giant beast and detained all villagers who bore witness to it but were unable to capture the elite squad of clones. Specimen A was soon sent back to its original destination for further unknown purposes.<ref name="Metamorphosis" />

Some time later, [[Omega]] discovered the beast's watery enclosure, which was guarded by TK stormtroopers. The Imperials used [[NNJ-40 "Thunderbolt" long-range ion cannon|ion cannons]] to keep the beast tamed.<ref name="Flash Strike">{{TBB|Flash Strike}}</ref> During her [[Skirmish on Wayland|escape from Tantiss]], Omega released the creature to divert the attention of Imperial units. The beast subsequently rampaged through the facility, eliminating two [[division]]s of [[TK stormtrooper]]s and several [[Imperial weapons technician|technicians]] and [[scientist]]s before escaping into the [[jungle]]s of Wayland.<ref name="TCHA">{{TBB|The Cavalry Has Arrived}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Specimen A appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' episode "[[Metamorphosis (episode)|Metamorphosis]]," which released on [[March 1]], [[2023]]. The Zillo Beast clone was identified as "Specimen A" in [[Aurebesh]] text displayed on a monitor in the episode.<ref name="Metamorphosis" />
